Independent complete dual Gray-code enumeration and MacWilliams prove A1..A5=0,A6=876. Full syndrome-support reconstruction and the two finite affine orbit sizes 219+657=876 prove exhaustive coverage. Both polynomial gcds are (X+1)g of degree19, stable under shifts and multiplier 2, giving individual cyclic spans dimension54. Exact class-specific pair counts on representatives and double-counting certify multiplicities 6,4,5,5; every assertion rerun by self-contained checker.

value.rationale: Structural classification of the exact minimum support configuration of a natural nonprimitive BCH code; each minimum word alone generates the full even-weight subcode, a useful precise generating-set invariant. Exact two affine orbits and four pair-incidence types identify non-design symmetry and correlations not measured by published weight counts. One fixed code, no unjustified broad extrapolation.
